a.lede: E-commerce platform Cleverbridge is warning that hackers breached its systems and stole customers' payment card information, including credit card numbers and CVV security codes. [...]
a.title: Cleverbridge warns hackers stole credit card numbers, CVVs in data breach

b.lede: Todoist said a hacker gained access to its production systems and stole customer data, including email IDs, password hashes, and account creation dates.
b.title: Todoist confirms 6% of customers’ details were stolen in data breach
